scope: scoped synthetic HTTP and retained checkpoint boundaries; no full suite, live traffic, UI or product acceptance

selection.scope: new independently registered bounded optional-axis route; strict old route unchanged; no live source grant
selection.regression: Fresh and retained request/type/context validation and required optional survival; exact finite registration; complete actual response preserved.

excluded.frontendVisual: Existing internal source pipeline only; no screen or user-facing behavior change

resources.ownedRoot: allocated by Scratch; manifest outside scratch before allocation
resources.finalizer: stop/join process groups; verify ps/lsof; remove exact owned dependency symlink; remove scratch and release host reservation; retain bounded failure logs and compact coverage/results

selector.actual: no affected-test plug-in for unspecified; running the full suite; command npm test (in .)
selector.review: Explicit four-file plan retained; fallback full suite excluded because existing session/capture/binder/collector callers are covered and no product/UI/application behavior changed.

red.reason: new source version refused at public-source-plan-refused before production changes

firstScoped.reason: synthetic eight-candidate helper left maxCandidates at1; corrected helper, no production defect

edges: exact line mandatory semantics and finite eight-request registration
fresh directly typed requested input axes; source-added options do not classify inputs
exact registered GET URL membership and source-version checkpoint identity
settings secrets stay ephemeral; retries and budgets remain bounded
complete actual solver capture and optional survival
semantic retained binding repeats exact request/type/context checks
resume/cache retained evidence rebind and canonical duplicate handling

observationLimits: V8 aggregate coverage collected during required validation; not isolated per test. Missing observations never establish irrelevance.
